description.value: Canada's Best Value Inn & Suites Vernon is a budget-oriented hotel operated under the Sonesta brand family, positioned off Highway 97 at 32nd Street in Vernon's North Okanagan corridor — a common through-route for cyclists travelling between the Lower Mainland and the Rockies. The property offers standard motel-style rooms with in-room appliances, a guest laundry facility, and truck and bus parking, making it functional for travellers with gear. A dense cluster of restaurants within 0.5 km provides easy access to evening meals.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content for this property is available and confirms the hotel is real and operating under the Sonesta/Canada's Best Value Inn brand. The website confirms phone number (250) 549-1241, provides a full address (4006 - 32nd Street, Vernon, BC V1T 5P1), and lists amenities including a guest laundry facility and free WiFi. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, drying area, breakfast, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the page.
